title: Smoky Irish Treacle BBQ Sauce Vegan Ribs
description: A vegan twist on traditional BBQ ribs, using intense smoky flavours and a sweet treacle glaze. Perfect for a summer evening.
instructions: Preheat your grill to medium heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together treacle, apple cider vinegar, smoky BBQ sauce, grill seasonings, smoked paprika and flaxseed meal.
Add the jackfruit to the bowl and toss to coat with the BBQ sauce mixture.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Add the jackfruit to the grill and cook for 20-25 minutes per side, or until tender and caramelized.
While the jackfruit is cooking, mix the water with the remaining BBQ sauce mixture and bring to a simmer in a saucepan.
Reduce the BBQ sauce mixture over medium heat until thickened and syrupy.
Once the jackfruit is cooked, brush with the BBQ sauce glaze and serve immediately.
Serve with additional BBQ sauce for dipping, if desired.
